1.consolidated_definition: Ahitarse, empacharse. “Usté escúlquela, polque a mí me parece que Lojo está más que empasiná.” Meléndez Muñoz, , p. 89.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To become stuffed or bloated; to feel uncomfortably full. "You listen to her, because it seems to me that Lojo is more than stuffed." Meléndez Muñoz, p. 89.
